Comisión Europea, Milk Market Observator.en: European Commission, Milk Market Observatory (Agri-food Data Portal): monthly price of raw cow milk paid to the producer in Spain, EUR/100 kg, last complete month. Figures for the latest month may be provisional. It is the Spanish reference; it is not the EU average. The API does not publish a release date: the day the figure was first retrieved is recorded.
Comisión Europea, Milk Market Observator.fr: Commission européenne, Observatoire du marché du lait (Milk Market Observatory, Agri-food Data Portal) : prix mensuel du lait cru de vache payé au producteur en Espagne, EUR/100 kg, dernier mois complet. Les chiffres du dernier mois peuvent être provisoires. C'est la référence espagnole ; ce n'est pas la moyenne de l'UE. L'API ne publie pas de date de publication : on enregistre le jour où la donnée a été récupérée pour la première fois.
Comisión Europea, Milk Market Observator.it: Commissione europea, Osservatorio del mercato del latte (Milk Market Observatory, Agri-food Data Portal): prezzo mensile del latte vaccino crudo pagato al produttore in Spagna, EUR/100 kg, ultimo mese completo. Le cifre dell'ultimo mese possono essere provvisorie. È il riferimento spagnolo; non è la media dell'UE. L'API non pubblica la data di pubblicazione: si registra il giorno in cui il dato è stato recuperato per la prima volta.

Statistics Canada, tabla 32-10-0077-01 (.en: Statistics Canada, table 32-10-0077-01 (Farm product prices, crops and livestock; Open Government Licence - Canada): monthly price paid to producers in Quebec, Unprocessed milk from bovine, published in CAD per kilolitre; expressed in CAD/100 kg using a density of 1.03 kg/l (standard for cow's milk). Canada does not publish a national total in this table: the reference province is used.
Statistics Canada, tabla 32-10-0077-01 (.fr: Statistique Canada, tableau 32-10-0077-01 (Farm product prices, crops and livestock; Open Government Licence - Canada) : prix mensuel payé aux producteurs au Québec, Unprocessed milk from bovine, publié en CAD per kilolitre ; exprimé en CAD/100 kg avec une densité de 1,03 kg/l (standard du lait de vache). Le Canada ne publie pas de total national dans ce tableau : on utilise la province de référence.
Statistics Canada, tabla 32-10-0077-01 (.it: Statistics Canada, tabella 32-10-0077-01 (Farm product prices, crops and livestock; Open Government Licence - Canada): prezzo mensile pagato ai produttori in Quebec, Unprocessed milk from bovine, pubblicato in CAD per kilolitre; espresso in CAD/100 kg con una densità di 1,03 kg/l (standard del latte vaccino). Il Canada non pubblica un totale nazionale in questa tabella: si usa la provincia di riferimento.

Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): pr.en: Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): average farm-gate milk price in the United Kingdom, sheet Prices_Monthly, in pence per litre; expressed in GBP/100 kg using a density of 1.03 kg/l (standard for cow's milk).
Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): pr.fr: Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0) : prix moyen du lait à la ferme au Royaume-Uni, feuille Prices_Monthly, en pence par litre ; exprimé en GBP/100 kg avec une densité de 1,03 kg/l (standard du lait de vache).
Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): pr.it: Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): prezzo medio del latte in azienda nel Regno Unito, foglio Prices_Monthly, in penny al litro; espresso in GBP/100 kg con una densità di 1,03 kg/l (standard del latte vaccino).

Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): Ag.en: Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): UK Agricultural Price Index (milk, prices received), base 2020=100. It is a price index, not a price in pounds.
Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): Ag.fr: Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0) : indice des prix agricoles du Royaume-Uni (lait, prix perçus), base 2020=100. Il s’agit d’un indice de prix, pas d’un prix en livres.
Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): Ag.it: Defra (Open Government Licence v3.0): indice dei prezzi agricoli del Regno Unito (latte, prezzi percepiti), base 2020=100. È un indice di prezzi, non un prezzo in sterline.
